frontend.line: Sign-in redirect loop: any new public page (e.g. /pricing) and /login must be in the publicRoutes matcher in apps/web/middleware.ts (Clerk protects all else), and afterSignInUrl must be /dashboard (NEXT_PUBLIC_CLERK_AFTER_SIGN_IN_URL). Staging loop from PR #828 (Lena's (auth) route group) is Lena's to fix; do not touch.
State: server state TanStack Query, client state zustand stores colocated with the feature (e.g. useInvoiceEditorStore); never mix. No Redux (ADR 0009; Lena wanted it for the invoice editor).
Tailwind v4 CSS-first config in apps/web/app/globals.css (@theme tokens); never create tailwind.config.js; use theme tokens (ring-primary), not hard-coded colors.

Dates: due dates show in the viewer's browser timezone (formatDueDate in apps/web/lib/dates.ts, no explicit timeZone; supersedes earlier org.timeZone rule); dueDate is plain YYYY-MM-DD, parse local with `T00:00:00`.
Money: use formatMoney(cents, currency, locale='en-CA') from apps/web/lib/money.ts / <Money>; never hard-code cents / 100.

Invoice.lineItems only present when request passes expand=lineItems (cached list rows lack it, detail crashes on .map; Sentry WEB-1F3); guard it or always request expand=lineItems (proposed, unconfirmed). Only status=open invoices can be overdue.
Forms use react-hook-form + zodResolver (@hookform/resolvers/zod); examples invoice-form.tsx, org-form.tsx, client-form.tsx.
Attachment uploads: presigned S3 PUT via POST /v1/uploads (300s), then POST /v1/uploads/:id/complete; progress bar needs XMLHttpRequest upload.onprogress (Lena wants it).
/pricing (PR #824) has placeholder prices (29/79/199); marketing must confirm real prices.
Import paths must match file name case exactly (macOS case-insensitive, Linux CI fails 'Module not found').
Skeleton is a default export plus SkeletonText; InvoiceRow renamed InvoiceListItem in acme-431-overdue-badge-drafts, conflicts with Lena's branch.

Jordan's trailmix app (Django+htmx): add-hike form uses hx-disabled-elt, hx-sync="this:drop"; only the form carries hx-* (a submit button's own hx-post double-posted); uploads need hx-encoding=multipart/form-data; validate_gpx.
Jordan's rule: test UI changes end to end in the running app before opening a PR and say what was checked (a date picker passed unit tests but broke in browser).
Web stack: Next.js 13.5.6 pages router; auth is Auth0 (@auth0/nextjs-auth0) per docs/architecture.md, though Clerk middleware/keys still appear (conflict); next-auth is an unused leftover.
Icon-only buttons need aria-label (icon aria-hidden); use shadcn/ui from apps/web/components/ui and lucide-react, not hand-rolled icons; sweep of other unlabelled buttons deferred.
Keep components under 150 lines with colocated tests (400-line invoice editor to be split later).
Loading-state bug: setLoading(true) then early return leaves spinner; use try/finally. Unfixed: ArchiveClientButton.tsx:18 (409), InviteMemberForm.tsx:31 (validation).
Branch acme-412-invoice-editor-store pushed, no PR yet; duplicateLine untested; LineItemRow last column 2.5rem too narrow for two icon buttons.
Webhooks settings page apps/web/pages/settings/webhooks.tsx corrected to X-Acme-Signature / HMAC SHA-256.

debugging.line: Sign-in redirect loop: check publicRoutes in apps/web/middleware.ts and afterSignInUrl=/dashboard; staging loop from PR #828 is Lena's, don't touch.
API auth 401 token_expired / invalid_token from requireAuth (apps/api/src/plugins/auth.ts).
Wrong invoice day: use viewer-local formatDueDate and parse dueDate as local (`T00:00:00`), not UTC.
Tests comparing local dates via toISOString fail after ~8pm Toronto (Jordan is EDT); pin clock with fake timers, check under TZ=America/Toronto and TZ=UTC.
Module not found on CI only: import case mismatch (macOS case-insensitive). 'Can't resolve fs': add import "server-only".
Image upload crash: `pnpm rebuild sharp` after Node switch; no Rosetta.
API tests hang when Docker stopped; check `docker info`.
/healthz (localhost:4000) 200 only if Postgres and Redis up; dev ports web 3000, worker metrics 9464, Postgres 5432, Redis 6379.
Worker outage 2026-08-22: Redis maxmemory (noeviction) from BullMQ completed jobs (1.78M); fixed removeOnComplete:1000 (PR #819).
Reconcile: allocations to soft-deleted invoices treated unapplied (fix 5a7e2c9, was TypeError 'amountCents' on Stripe webhook).
CLI: `acme login` device flow fails exit 1 on denied/expired; ERR_REQUIRE_ESM means old Node, tell customer Node 18+ and reinstall.
Excel garbles accents: CLI export --bom. Staging 502s ~40s on deploys; CLI retries. Draft invoices lack lineItems (WEB-1F3).
Invoice detail crash on lineItems.map: API only returns lineItems with expand=lineItems; list cache rows lack it.
`acme webhooks test` reads webhookSecret from ~/.acme/config.json (not env); errors if missing (`acme config set webhookSecret`). CLI exit 2 usage errors, 1 runtime.
HEIC (iPhone) uploads fail in sharp; suggest client convert or reject at POST /v1/uploads.
E2E: need dev server on 3000 first; invoices/detail.spec.ts 'downloads pdf' 404s (seed inv_e2e_1 has no pdfKey, fixture gap, also fails nightly staging).
Stuck spinner buttons: early return without resetting loading state (ArchiveClientButton.tsx:18, InviteMemberForm.tsx:31 unfixed).
Preview 'Clerk: production build detected with development keys': .github/workflows/preview.yml:41 passes CLERK_PUBLISHABLE_KEY_DEV; needs platform team approval to fix.
Before saying done, re-check work for bugs and security issues.

Tailwind v4 CSS-first; theme tokens, no tailwind.config.js.
Validation is zod everywhere (no joi, no hand-rolled ifs); schemas in apps/api/src/schemas/; routes use safeParse, 400 invalid_body.

No emojis in code, commit messages or docs.

Use @acme/shared/... path aliases (@acme/* -> packages/*/src), not deep relative imports.
CLI exit codes: 2 usage (UsageError), 1 runtime (packages/cli/src/lib/errors.ts); bad args print one line, no stack trace.
Components under 150 lines with colocated tests; re-check for bugs/security before done.

jobs.line: Worker consumes RabbitMQ queues invoices.reminders, webhooks.outbound, exports (one consumer each); BullMQ queues invoices, emails, webhooks also exist.
Jobs retry exponential backoff (5 attempts), then dlq and Slack #alerts.
Outage 2026-08-22: Redis hit maxmemory (noeviction) because BullMQ kept completed jobs; now removeOnComplete:1000, removeOnFail:5000 in services/worker/src/queues.ts (PR #819).
Prod Redis is ElastiCache, single shard, cluster mode off.
Marco wants rate limiter (services/worker/src/ratelimit.ts) Redis-backed in prod; review: take() must be an atomic Lua script, reset() must use SCAN not KEYS, add Redis-path test.
invoice-reminder idempotent via db.reminderLog.claim on reminder_log (unique invoice_id/kind/sent_on).
Reminder subjects (send-reminder.ts reminderSubject): 'Reminder: INV-... is due in N days', 'is due today', 'INV-... is N days overdue'; UTC calendar days.
KEDA scales worker 1-20 replicas (1 per 50 msgs); manifests infra/k8s/.
Priya wants SQS queue for CSV exports (suggest exports-jobs + exports-dlq in infra/src/queues.ts); not created.
Worker tests: `pnpm --filter worker test` with ioredis-mock.

Reminder job idempotency (sendReminder.ts: sentAt check, conditional claim on claimedAt, idempotencyKey to mailer) needs a Prisma migration adding nullable reminder.claimedAt; not written, Jordan said later.
Worker concurrency 5 per process (WORKER_CONCURRENCY, queues.ts); for month-end backlog raise max replicas, not per-process concurrency.
